about: A cash-out at the cage (scope-v1 module 5; design prompt flow 8): chips handed back, in whole ₹50 chips above nothing, first settle the member's open markers, oldest first, each as far as the chips go; what is left goes to the member, in cash or to their wallet. A member with an open marker never takes chips' worth in cash before it is settled. Markers are listed oldest first, separated by |; nothing is rounded.

cases.description: Flow 8: ₹1,20,000 of chips with an open ₹50,000 marker: the marker settles, ₹70,000 to Arjun.
No markers: every chip to the member.
Less than the marker: ₹30,000 settles part of ₹50,000, nothing to the member.
Exactly the marker: it settles, nothing to the member.
Two markers, oldest first: ₹60,000 settles ₹50,000 and ₹10,000 of the next ₹20,000.
Two markers and more: ₹1,00,000 settles both, ₹30,000 to the member.
